privacy.seoDescription: Karanta manufar sirri ta CHADI International game da yadda ake sarrafa bayanan da aka raba ta wannan shafin yanar gizo.
privacy.title: Manufar Sirri
privacy.subtitle: Yadda CHADI ke sarrafa bayanan da aka raba ta wannan shafin yanar gizo.
privacy.lastUpdated: An sabunta na ƙarshe: wannan manufar tana bayyana yadda wannan shafin ke sarrafa bayanai a yau. Wuri ne mai kyau na farawa, ba madadin dubawar lauya mai cancanta ba kafin ku dogara da shi don dalilan bin ƙa'ida.

collect.title: Bayanan da muke tarawa
collect.body: Muna tara abin da kuka zaɓa ku miƙa ta hanyar fom ɗin wannan shafin: sunanku da imel a kan fom ɗin tuntuɓa, ba da agaji, wasiƙar labarai da sha'awar bayarwa, tare da duk wani abu da wani fom na musamman ke buƙata (misali sha'awar ku lokacin ba da agaji). Idan kuka yi gudummawa, Paystack (mai sarrafa biyan kuɗin mu) na raba sunanku, imel, adadin gudummawa da lambar biyan kuɗi da mu domin mu iya rikodin gudummawar ku mu aiko muku da rasit - bayanan katin ku ana shigar da su kai tsaye cikin tsarin biyan kuɗi na Paystack kuma ba sa taɓa wuce ta sabobinmu.

cookies.title: Kukis
cookies.body: Wannan shafin da kansa ba ya saita kukis na bibiya. Idan kun karɓi bayanin kukis, muna loda bincike mai kula da sirri, marar kukis (Plausible) don fahimtar zirga-zirga gaba ɗaya - ba ya amfani da kukis ko bibiyar ku ɗaya-ɗaya a wasu shafuka. Dashboard na admin na kiyaye ma'aikata sa hannu ta amfani da ma'ajiyar gida ta burauzarku, ba kuki ba. Tsarin biyan kuɗi na Paystack na iya saita kukis nasa a kan dominsa yayin da kuke kammala biyan kuɗi, wanda manufar sirri ta Paystack ke tafiyar da shi, ba namu ba.

usage.title: Yadda muke amfani da bayananku
usage.body: Don amsa tambayoyi, sarrafa da rasit gudummawa, bibiyar aikace-aikacen ba da agaji, aiko sabuntawar wasiƙar labarai da kuka yi rijista da su, da tafiyar da ayyukan asali na shafin. Ba ma sayar da bayanan sirri, kuma ba ma amfani da abin da kuka raba don wani abu bayan waɗannan dalilai ba tare da tambayarku farko ba.

sharing.title: Waɗanda muke raba shi da su
sharing.body: Kawai ɓangarori na uku da ake buƙata don bayar da sabis ɗin da kuka nema: Paystack (sarrafa biyan kuɗi), mai bayar da sabis na imel ɗin mu (aika rasit, amsoshi da wasiƙar labarai), kuma, idan an kunna, Plausible (bincike) da Sentry (kula da kuskure, don taimaka mana gyara matsaloli). Ba ma sayarwa ko hayar bayananku ga wani. Samun dama a cikin CHADI an takaita ga membobin ƙungiyar da suke buƙatarsa don yin aikinsu.

retention.title: Tsawon lokacin da muke ajiyewa
retention.body: Muna ajiye bayanan da aka miƙa muddin yana da amfani don dalilin da kuka raba shi (misali aikace-aikacen ba da agaji mai aiki, rikodin gudummawa don lissafinmu), ko har sai kun nemi mu goge shi - duk abin da ya dace.

rights.title: Haƙƙoƙin ku
rights.body: Dangane da inda kuke, kuna iya samun haƙƙin samun dama, gyarawa, gogewa, ko karɓar kwafin bayanan da muke rikewa game da ku, ko ƙin yadda ake amfani da su. Don yin amfani da ɗayan waɗannan, ko sabunta ko cire bayanan da kuka raba da mu, ku tuntuɓe mu ta

children.title: Sirrin yara

usage.title: Amfani da wannan shafin
usage.body: Wannan shafin yanar gizo na raba bayanai game da shirye-shiryen CHADI, ayyuka, abubuwan da suka faru da damarmaki. Ana bayar da abun ciki don bayani na gaba ɗaya kuma ana iya sabunta shi yayin da shirye-shirye ke ci gaba. Kun yarda kada ku yi amfani da shafin ba daidai ba, ku miƙa ƙarya ta hanyar fom ɗinsa, ko ku yi ƙoƙarin tarwatsa dandalin ko sabis ɗin da yake haɗawa da su.

content.title: Abun ciki da mallakar fasaha
content.body: Rubutu, hotuna da sauran abun ciki a wannan shafin na CHADI International ne ko ana amfani da su da izini, sai dai an bayyana akasin haka. Kuna maraba da raba hanyoyin haɗi zuwa abun cikinmu; sake amfani da shi a wani wuri yana buƙatar izininmu na rubutu tukuna.

donations.title: Gudummawa
donations.body: Gudummawar da aka yi ta wannan shafin gudummawa ne na son rai ga aikin CHADI International. Ana sarrafa biyan kuɗi ta hanyar Paystack cikin aminci; ba ma taɓa ganin ko ajiye bayanan katin ku ba. Idan kun yi gudummawa ba daidai ba ko kuna da damuwa game da wani caji, ku tuntuɓe mu ta
donations.bodyEnd: kuma za mu yi aiki da ku a kai.

thirdParty.title: Hanyoyin haɗi na ɓangare na uku
thirdParty.body: Wannan shafin na iya haɗawa da shafukan yanar gizo na ɓangare na uku (abokan hulɗa, kafofin sada zumunta, masu ba da biyan kuɗi). Ba mu da alhakin abun ciki ko ayyukan shafukan da ba mu sarrafa su ba.

liability.title: Babu garanti; iyakance alhaki
liability.body: Ana bayar da wannan shafin da abun cikinsa "kamar yadda yake," ba tare da wani garanti ba. Zuwa ga iyakar da doka ta ba da izini, CHADI International ba ta da alhakin duk wata asara kai tsaye ko ta zahiri da ta taso daga amfani da wannan shafin.

governingLaw.title: Dokar da ke tafiyar da shi
governingLaw.body: Waɗannan sharuɗɗa dokokin Tarayyar Najeriya ne ke tafiyar da su, ba tare da la'akari da ƙa'idodin karo na doka ba.

changes.title: Canje-canje ga waɗannan sharuɗɗa
changes.body: CHADI na iya sabunta waɗannan sharuɗɗa yayin da shafin da sabis ɗinsa ke girma. Cigaba da amfani da shafin bayan wani canji na nufin kun yarda da sabuntattun sharuɗɗan.

ourStory.p1: Caleb Hope Alive Development Initiative (CHADI) ƙungiya ce mai zaman kanta da ke sadaukar da kai wajen ƙarfafa waɗanda aka ware da al'ummomin da ba a kula da su ba a fadin Najeriya ta hanyar ci gaba mai dorewa, ilimi, kiwon lafiya, sabuntawa, da shiga tsakani na jin ƙai.
ourStory.p2: Mun yi imani kowane mutum ya cancanci mutunci, dama, ingantaccen kiwon lafiya, ilimi, da bege ba tare da la'akari da inda suke zama ba ko yanayin da ke kewaye da su.
ourStory.quote: Muna maido da mutunci, samar da dama, da kuma kawo bege — ta hanyar aiki.
